name: Constance
source:
She is the daughter of the village chief of Garil, a village on the eastern edge of the Gareth Empire.

Her mother has already passed away from illness, and although she is still old enough to work, she supports her father, who has a bad leg, and lives her days off.

Although there is nothing particularly noteworthy about her personality or behavior, she is around the same age as her mother and has a beautiful appearance.
